scope: controlled 6-round reduced-key exact structural falsifier; distinct from failed XOR separability
exact_test: For modulus 2^m, Q_m[a,b]=(S[a,b]-S[a,0]-S[0,b]+S[0,0]) mod 2^m. Width m is exact modular-additive separable iff Q_m is zero for all 65,536 cells.
selection_rule: Select the largest m in [4,8,12,16] that is exact on all four targets. This rule is frozen before inspection.
match_rule: For selected exact m, use row0/column0 modular signatures only. Count every (low,high) pair satisfying S_m(low,0)+S_m(0,high)-S_m(0,0)=0 mod 2^m. True key is used only to check inclusion after the match set is formed.
secondary_diagnostics: 2-adic valuation histogram of full modular residual
stage1_only_if_primary_pass: Freeze fresh widths/targets and explicit MITM TOTAL accounting. No alpha<1 claim from b16 structural PASS alone.
kill_rule: If no common exact modular width >=8 exists, or any fresh target has >512 matches under the selected width, close the simple modular-additive 8+8 MITM family immediately.
forbidden: No target/layout/split/modulus threshold retuning after results. Approximate residual concentration cannot rescue failed exact separability.
